simple.summary: מְחִלָּה (mᵉchillâh) means a cavern (as if excavated) First listed occurrence: Isa 2 19.

definitions.full: H4247. mechillah [ מְחִלָּה ] noun feminine hole , עָפָר מְחִלּוֺת holes of the dust Isa 2:19 (|| צֻרִים מְעָרוֺת caves of the rocks ).
